train_end = '2023-05-31'

train_values = train_df['Value1'].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
assert len(train_values) == 151, len(train_values)

mean = float(train_values.mean())
scale = float(train_values.std(ddof=0))
scaled = (train_values - mean) / scale
scaled32 = scaled.astype(np.float32)

LOOKBACK = 10
HIDDEN = 32
LAYERS = 1
EPOCHS = 300
LR = 0.01

X_list, y_list = [], []
for i in range(LOOKBACK, len(scaled32)):
    X_list.append(scaled32[i-LOOKBACK:i])
    y_list.append(scaled32[i])
